name: FrameAssembly
description: A Domain-Specific Language (DSL), optimizing compiler, and PCAP-to-.frasm decompiler written in Rust 2024 that compiles strict-lowercase network packet code (.frasm) into deterministic, nanosecond-precision classic libpcap (.pcap) and PCAPNG (.pcapng) packet captures—and decompiles .pcap / .pcapng captures back into canonical .frasm code (bidirectional .frasm <-> .pcap/.pcapng compilation and decompilation)—across 81 native Layer 2 through Layer 7 protocols (2,600+ verified .frasm scenarios).
